basic_info.description: Welcome to this reimagined and exquisitely remodeled home in the highly desirable Central Sunset! This home soars with an open floor plan, combining elegance and practicality that are catered to today's modern living. The main floor offers two bedrooms with gorgeous OCEAN VIEWS, two bathrooms and a flowing seamless open concept kitchen, dining room and living room - perfect for hosting guests and entertainment! The gourmet kitchen centers around a large island and features European style cabinetry and professional stainless steel appliances. The ground floor welcomes you with a bright and spacious family room, wet bar, two bedrooms and one bathroom. This home was completely remodeled to the studs. It comes with a brand new roof, beautiful hardwood floors throughout, and abundant natural light from new windows and skylights. Many thoughtful features including 200-amp PG&E service upgrade, EV charging outlet, tankless water heater, electric fireplace, beverage cooler and under cabinet lighting. The thoughtfully designed backyard features a low maintenance lawn and brand new fences. Noriega and Irving St shopping, Safeway, Sunset reservoir, GG Park, Sonestown, Wholefoods, Trader Joes, HMart, Lake Merced and bus stops are all minutes away. Easy freeway access. Enjoy your new home!
